name: bm-player
description: A professional media player powered by mpv — TV/IPTV, gallery, music library with tag reading, and a PDF suite

scripts.build:win64: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:win32: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --win --ia32
scripts.build:mac: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:lite-win64: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.lite.yml --win --x64
scripts.build:lite-win32: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.lite.yml --win --ia32
scripts.build:lite-mac: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.lite.yml --mac
scripts.build:lite-linux: npm test && npm run gen-icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.lite.yml --linux
scripts.test: npm run lint:syntax && npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:electron && npm run lint:powershell && npm run test:plugins && npm run test:main && npm run test:modules && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:mpv
scripts.test:main: node scripts/smoke-main.cjs && node scripts/smoke-main.cjs --compat-run && node scripts/smoke-main.cjs --lite-run
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/e2e.mjs --part=a && node scripts/e2e.mjs --part=b && node scripts/e2e.mjs --part=c

author: BM Player
